verdict.rationale: Wise documents a first-party Delivery Estimate API that returns when funds are expected to arrive in the recipient's bank account, so the core capability of seeing a delivery estimate exists. The evidence does not show the estimate being displayed before the user confirms, or that it applies to ACH or wire rails. It also describes an estimate rather than an exact delivery time. missing for 10: evidence the estimate is shown pre-confirmation in the Business UI/flow, explicit ACH and wire coverage, precision/exactness of the estimate, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can see the exact delivery estimate for an ACH or wire transfer before confirming it

citations.quote: Get the estimated delivery time for a transfer, showing when funds are expected to arrive in the recipient's bank account.
